descriptionChirho: To actively separate, divide, or set apart persons or things from one another, whether for ritual consecration, physical division, or selection (causative active Hifil).
To make a cognitive or judicial distinction between categories such as holy and profane, clean and unclean, functioning as 'to differentiate' rather than physical separation.
To be separated (passive) or to separate oneself, withdraw from a group or community (reflexive Nifal), often describing voluntary or commanded self-exclusion.
